claim: A stolen proof-runner session cannot execute more protected API operations than the server-configured per-session action budget, including under concurrent requests.

evidenceBoundary.scale: one proof-runner key / one synthetic tenant / one account / two concurrent requests

red.observation: The proof-runner configuration rejected actionBudget as unsupported, confirming that issued bearer sessions had no server-enforced action-count limit.

repair.configuration: Each trusted runner must declare an integer actionBudget from 1 through 100; unsupported, missing or out-of-range values fail closed.
repair.issuance: The budget is copied into the session and append-only issuance audit; the runner cannot choose or increase it.
repair.enforcement: After method/path authorization, one atomic SQLite update consumes one action. Concurrent requests cannot both consume the final action.
repair.denial: The first over-budget request records one append-only exhaustion event and returns HTTP 429; subsequent attempts remain denied without duplicating the event.
repair.scopeOrdering: An out-of-scope request is denied with HTTP 403 before budget consumption, preserving the budget for configured proof work.
repair.killSwitch: Disabling the runner identity continues to fail closed before budget evaluation.

coverage: passkey Origin, user-verification and replay controls
atomic proof-runner action budget, scope denial, replay denial, audit and kill switch

green.overlayIdempotence: The proof-runner hardener applied twice to a fresh extraction and the resulting server passed syntax validation.

releaseGate.reason: This result executed locally on Node 24.19.0, not the required Node 22.23.2 release runtime, and the proof-runner remains unconfigured in the approved hosted synthetic lane. Hosted concurrency, exact Golden Journey sizing, key custody/rotation and OIDC/provider federation are unproved.
releaseGate.nextProof: Execute the same atomic exhaustion regression inside the exact Node 22.23.2 Docker candidate, then size and enforce a minimal route/action budget for one approved hosted Golden Journey and verify kill-switch denial on the deployed SHA.
